variants.headline: Still in view: accident at a workplace
variants.sub: The workplace {facility} has had an accident.
variants.body:
An accident has occurred at {facility}. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

Going to work should not make a person's safety an afterthought. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: Still in view: workplace safety becomes immediate news
variants.sub: There has been an accident at {facility}.
